subject: LumenBridge private deployment — request for limited egress, audit window & discount
messages:
From: Maya O'Neill <maya.oneill@lumenbridge.ai>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@lumenbridge.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:12:00Z
Subject: Private deploy ask: in-country residency, restricted egress, and committed discount

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with Redwood's runtime. A few critical items came up in our procurement/legal checklist that we need to confirm before we can sign:

- Data residency: production customer data must remain in our US-only VPC region (no replication outside US).
- Audit window: our SOC/audit vendor requires one time-boxed 7-day access window per year with on-site inspection option.
- Egress restriction: any egress to 3rd parties must be explicitly approved; we need outbound network controls and an egress attest.
- Commercial ask: given our 24/7 uptime SLA requirement and committed 2-year capacity, we are asking for a 30% volume discount and a one-time onboarding credit to cover agent installation.

I've attached the current SOW and a redline of our audit annex. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate these items and what approvals are needed? We need to get internal sign-off by end of next week.

Appreciate a clear call-to-action so we can move this with procurement.

Best,
Maya O'Neill
Head of Infrastructure, LumenBridge
Attachments: LumenBridge_SOW_v3.pdf, Mutual-Audit-Annex.docx

From: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
To: Maya O'Neill <maya.oneill@lumenbridge.ai>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@lumenbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-15T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deploy ask: in-country residency, restricted egress, and committed discount

Maya — thanks for the clear summary and the docs. Short answers up front: we can support an in-country-only VPC and a time-boxed audit window, but there are two items that will need Deal Desk / Exec signoff: the 30% committed discount and the on-site audit option (physical access exceptions).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll pull legal + deal desk in and share Redwood's standard Mutual Audit Annex + a proposed addendum for on-site procedures.
2) Marissa (cc'd) will run the pricing impact and provide a recommended discount cap.
3) If needed, we'll escalate to Karthik for one-off approval on discounts and to Lauren for any SLA/terms carveouts.

Can you confirm whether LumenBridge requires a standing on-site audit right every year or just the one-time optional physical inspection? That drives risk and our approval path.

I'll follow up internally and aim to get a clear yes/no on the items by EOD tomorrow.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-16T09:30:00Z
Subject: Fwd: LumenBridge private deploy — pricing & audit request (calcs attached)

Forwarding LumenBridge request and my preliminary impact calc. Sean — please see the attached pricing workbook (summary below).

Summary:
- 2-year committed capacity (Nvidia-class GPUs): baseline ARR $1.2M/yr.
- 30% discount would reduce ARR to ~$840k/yr — margin impact significant at our target. Recommend discount cap of 18% for standard reserved capacity plus a $50k onboarding credit (one-off).
- On-site audit: operational cost estimate $25k/visit (security escort, engineer time). Allowing a 1-time on-site inspection with a defined playbook and indemnities is possible; recurring annual on-sites are a hard no unless under exceptional compliance regimes.

Ask for Execs/Deal Desk:
- Approve up to 20% committed discount (with stepped threshold tied to usage).
- Approve $50k one-time onboarding credit.
- Approve controlled 7-day time-boxed audit window + single optional on-site inspection with redacted data safeguards and monitored access.

Attachments: pricing_impact_lumenbridge.xlsx (link in related_links)

Marissa
Director, Deal Desk

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-16T13:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: LumenBridge private deploy — pricing & audit request (calcs attached)

Thanks for the breakdown. I discussed with legal and infra ops. Quick decision to keep momentum: I approve the following one-off concessions for LumenBridge, subject to the noted controls below.

Approved concessions (conditional):
- Discount: up to 20% on committed capacity for a 2-year term. Discount will be applied via tiered pricing: 15% at contract signature, escalates to 20% if utilization >= 85% for both quarters in year 1.
- Onboarding credit: $50,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice.
- Audit: Redwood will allow a single 7-day time-boxed remote audit window per contract year. We will also permit a one-time optional physical inspection for year 1 only, under these hard controls:
  * Physical access limited to pre-approved vendor auditors; Redwood engineer must accompany and supervise; no raw production data leaves premises; collection must be done on network taps we control.
  * All findings are handled under mutual NDA + redaction process; Redwood retains the right to decline any direct data access that risks customer data leakage.
  * On-site cost recovery: LumenBridge will reimburse reasonable operational costs (estimate $25k) unless otherwise negotiated into the SOW.

Non-negotiables: 1) no permanent cross-border replication, 2) egress must be explicit and logged; any third-party outbound will require prior approval.

Legal should produce the redline with the Mutual-Audit-Annex edits and the addendum capturing these controls. Once legal posts those, Marissa — please produce the final quote and updated SOW for signature.

Karthik
VP, Finance & Deal Strategy

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com

1) Pricing sheet will show the 15% starter discount with an automated upsell clause to 20% when utilization triggers are met (we should include a data export clause for verification).
2) I'll include a cost-recovery line item for any on-site expenses and capture the runbook for supervised inspections (to be attached to the SOW).

Sean — can you schedule a 30-minute call with Maya & Carlos tomorrow to review the approved concessions and confirm the audit logistics? I'll have the preliminary commercial redline ready by EOD tomorrow.

Marissa

Maya / Carlos — quick update: Redwood can support the VPC-only residency, a single 7-day time-boxed remote audit per year, and a one-time optional supervised on-site inspection in year 1.
